# Is a secret baked into your Docker image?

> Paste your Dockerfile and find every ENV or ARG instruction whose name looks like a secret, and every COPY/ADD of a credential file like .env or id_rsa into the build. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
